ref: Feigenbaum Teen Siddur, Nusach Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharis, Hashkamas Ha'boker, Modeh Ani
he: מוֹדֶה אֲנִי לְפָנֶֽיךָ מֶֽלֶךְ חַי וְקַיָּם שֶׁהֶחֱזַֽרְתָּ בִּי נִשְׁמָתִי בְּחֶמְלָה, רַבָּה אֱמוּנָתֶֽךָ:

textBlocks.text: Thank You, Hashem, for giving my neshamah back to me (which was a merciful thing to do since I have not yet lived up to my full potential, and therefore may not really deserve that); Your belief in me is very great! (You believe I am important; my struggles are important; and You believe I can climb up to the next rung — which is why You woke me up. Thank You!)
